div.head: An online dictionary of pre-Conquest English law
div.p: eLiebermann is a digital edition of the Wörterbuch, the dictionary in Felix Liebermann's Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen, the standard edition of the laws of England before the Norman Conquest. It covers the Old English, Latin and French words of the law codes and related texts, with every citation to the laws and manuscripts linked to an explanation.
The dictionary is being built entry by entry. Each entry gives Liebermann's text as printed, and the team adds English translations and links to other dictionaries as they go.
